_meta.about: Texts of the Streambox dashboard tile (Jellyfin: now playing, this week's episodes from Sonarr, server load, recently added) and its settings page (Settings, Utilities, Streambox). The Discord messages are not here (they have their own language setting). Product names (Streambox, Jellyfin, Sonarr, Seedbox, Sysbox, Unraid, Discord, Shelly, Quick Sync) are not translated.

set.help_discord.text: Discord cards: Unraid checks Jellyfin every minute. A movie is announced once its description (in Jellyfin's metadata language) and poster exist; episodes are grouped per season and announced when no new episode has arrived for the "wait for more episodes" time. The first time the notifier is switched on, only items added from then on are announced. The weekly summary lists everything added in the last 7 days at the chosen day and hour (server time zone); if the server was off at that hour it is sent when it is next up the same day. The buttons use the saved settings, so press Apply first. The Jellyfin link in the cards is left out when the Jellyfin link URL is empty. Create a webhook in Discord under channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks.
set.help_discord.note: grey paragraph at the bottom of the page about the Discord cards. "wait for more episodes" names the setting above.

set.help_general.text: The Jellyfin API key is created in Jellyfin under Dashboard, Advanced, API Keys. Streams that are idle (nothing playing) are not shown. GPU load is read with intel_gpu_top, CPU load from the system statistics. Leave the Jellyfin link URL empty to use this server's address with the Jellyfin port. Leave the smart socket address empty to hide the Socket reading. The monthly consumption is taken from the socket's own energy counter, which Unraid samples every 10 minutes, so the first month counts from the day the socket is set up.
set.help_general.note: grey paragraph at the bottom of the page. Menu names of Jellyfin (Dashboard, Advanced, API Keys) should match Jellyfin's own words in your language.

set.jx_on.note: label of a setting (left column, ends with a colon).

set.jx_on_hint.text: IMDb rating on every movie, series and episode, a Watched menu and a "Watched too" switch on the home page
set.jx_on_hint.note: text next to the checkbox (web client and Jellyfin Desktop). "Watched too" is the name of the switch: use the same words as jx.watched_too.

set.jx_on_long.text: Uses the folder and the JS Injector script of the row above (week.js loads extras.js), so the row setting may be off. Once a day Streambox downloads IMDb's public ratings file (title.ratings.tsv.gz, about 9 MB, for personal and non-commercial use) and keeps only the titles of this Jellyfin library in imdb.json. Anyone who can open the Jellyfin address can read imdb.json (Jellyfin item ids, IMDb ids and ratings).
set.jx_on_long.note: hint under the IMDb and Watched setting. May contain simple HTML tags: keep them.

jx.watched_too.note: switch on Jellyfin's home page, in the header of the first poster row. On (default): rows also show what the user has already watched; off: those are hidden. Short.

jx.watched_too_tip.text: Off: the Recently added rows leave out what you have already watched. It is Jellyfin's own setting of your account (Settings, Home), so it works in the Jellyfin apps too; the page reloads.
jx.watched_too_tip.note: tooltip of the Watched too switch.

jx.menu.note: menu entry in Jellyfin (next to Movies, Shows...) and the title of its page: the movies and series the user has watched. One short word.

jx.tab.movies.note: tab on the Watched page; {n} = number of watched movies.

jx.tab.series.note: tab on the Watched page; {n} = number of series with at least one watched episode.

jx.sort.note: label before the sort list on the Watched page.

jx.sort.date.note: sort option on the Watched page (newest first).

jx.sort.name.note: sort option on the Watched page (A to Z).

jx.sort.imdb.note: sort option on the Watched page (best first).

jx.when.note: green line under a poster on the Watched page; {date} = day and month in the browser's format, e.g. 'Oct 18'.

jx.done.note: tooltip of the check mark on a series poster on the Watched page: every episode watched.

jx.empty_movies.note: Watched page, Movies tab, when the list is empty.

jx.empty_series.note: Watched page, Shows tab, when the list is empty.

jx.loading.note: Watched page while the list comes from Jellyfin.

jx.error.text: Jellyfin did not send the list. Close this page and open it again.
jx.error.note: Watched page when the request to Jellyfin failed.

jx.close.note: tooltip of the × button on the Watched page.

jx.imdb_open.note: tooltip of the yellow IMDb badge (cards and detail page); the click opens the title's IMDb page in a new tab.

jx.votes.note: IMDb vote count, in the IMDb badge tooltip and next to the rating on the detail page; {v} = the number with thousands separators, {n} = the plain number for the plural form.

jx.eps.note: under a series poster on the Watched page: how many of its episodes the user has watched.

set.jx_badge.note: label of a setting (left column, ends with a colon).

set.jx_badge.title.note: option of the IMDb badge setting: under the poster, after the title.

set.jx_badge.poster.note: option of the IMDb badge setting: on the picture's top left corner.
